sources.shortCitation: Grammophon 885, “Eine Sommernacht am Meer” (Fred Marley Orchestra, 1932)
sources.fullCitation: Fred Marley und sein Tanz-Orchester, with Leo Monosson identified as refrain vocalist. “Eine Sommernacht am Meer.” Grammophon 885, matrix 1703 BN3; recorded at the Schumannsaal, Berlin, 15 August 1932. Music credited to Bob Handers; words by Fritz Rotter. Title list at musiktiteldb.de, citing Discographie der deutschen Tanzmusik, vol. 8.
sources.title: Eine Sommernacht am Meer — Grammophon 885
sources.creator: Fred Marley und sein Tanz-Orchester; Leo Monosson, refrain vocal
sources.researchNote: The title-list entry identifies Grammophon 885, matrix 1703 BN3, and names Leo Monosson as refrain vocalist from a discography; it does not specify a disc side or an issue date. A separate row lists Polydor 24622 with matrix 1704 BN3 and does not name the vocalist. Bob Handers was the joint recording pseudonym used by Bronisław Kaper and Walter Jurmann.
